meta.description: Build sequence logos from aligned DNA, RNA, or protein motifs using ggseqlogo (R), Logomaker (Python), or WebLogo with explicit bits vs probability encoding, correctly computed non-uniform-background relative entropy, custom alphabets, and multi-logo stacking.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.execution_note: Exact evidence is run/exact-commit-20260923-200710. The known Windows R/ggseqlogo CLI teardown crash occurs after even a minimal library load; R tests use only a process-local R_PROFILE_USER cleanup guard, with cli_unloaded=TRUE receipts. The guard is neither global configuration nor a skill requirement.

scientific_integrity.detail: The claimed non-uniform-background route now computes relative entropy instead of passing an ignored parameter. The 72% GC Streptomyces composition is presented as illustrative, not independently sourced.

practice_boundaries.detail: Motif visualization only; no diagnostic or prescriptive claim.

methodological_ground.detail: Uniform bits, background relative entropy, signed log-odds, and non-equivalent low-N tool defaults are explicitly separated.

code_usability.detail: The exact checkout helper, complete example, Logomaker snippet, and WebLogo DNA/RNA commands completed with the recorded outputs.

functional_suitability.note: All three routes distinguish uniform bits from non-uniform-background relative entropy.

reliability.note: Alphabet/background validation and low-N/RNA/dependency limits are explicit.

performance_context.note: Reusable helper and small bundled fixtures make the central workflow reproducible.

agent_usability.note: Tool choice, current API signatures, and labels agree with the calculation.

human_usability.note: Direct prompts, decision table, and concise boundaries are clear.

security.note: No credentials, network operation, or destructive cleanup; outputs are local PDFs.

maintainability.note: The calculation is separately testable and shipped fixture data remove undefined inputs.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and hand-offs; external package APIs still require version inspection.
